account.trouble.undoLede: For 24 hours after a number change, the account can be put back on the number it had.
guide.title: Help
guide.lede: How this app works, and what to do when something goes wrong.
archive.title: Consignment notes
archive.lede: Every note you were a party to, kept as it read at each signature.
archive.error: Could not load your consignment notes
archive.errorRetry: Could not load your consignment notes.
archive.emptyLong: Nothing here yet. A note is filed the moment goods are taken over, and again at every signature after it.
archive.stage.reloaded: Moved to another of the carrier’s vehicles
archive.stage.sealChanged: A seal changed on the road
archive.stage.coldChainBroken: The cold chain broke on the road
archive.copiesLede: A consignment note is made out in originals that stop changing — the sender’s at taking over, the consignee’s at delivery. Each copy below is one of those moments. The short code is its fingerprint: two people holding two printouts can compare that one line.
archive.exportBundle: Download this note and its photographs
archive.shareBundle: Share this note and its photographs
archive.shareBundleHint: Opens your phone’s own share sheet — send it to your Drive, Dropbox, a chat or your mail. One file holding every copy, the photographs behind them, and a list of anything already past its retention window.
archive.nowhereYet: These notes are not going anywhere but here.
archive.nowhereYetGo: Send them to your own storage
archive.exportBundleHint: One file holding every copy, the photographs behind them, and a list of anything already past its retention window.
archive.retention.title: How long we keep this
archive.retention.open: We keep this note for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} after the load is finished, and the photographs behind it for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. This load is not finished, so nothing has started counting.
archive.retention.until: We keep this note until {doc}, and the photographs behind it until {photos}.
archive.retention.claimGap: A claim on this carriage can be brought until {claim}, which is after the photographs go. Download your own copy before {date}.
archive.retention.proof: After those dates we can still confirm that a copy you hold is genuine, from its fingerprint — but we cannot give you another one.
dest.title: Your own copy, delivered
dest.lede: We delete these notes twelve months after the load finishes. Connect your own storage and every finished consignment is put there automatically — one file per note, with its photographs, before we let go of ours.
dest.noneYet: Nothing is connected, so the only copies you keep are the ones you download by hand.
dest.kind.s3Who: Amazon S3, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, Cloudflare R2, Ceph, and most NAS boxes.
dest.kind.webdavWho: Nextcloud, ownCloud, SharePoint, Synology, QNAP — anything that gives you a WebDAV address.
dest.kind.webhook: Send it to our own system
dest.kind.webhookWho: We POST each bundle to an address you run, signed so you can prove it came from us.
dest.https: The address has to be https, and it cannot be inside a private network — we will not send your documents somewhere we cannot verify.
dest.testOkDetail: We wrote {key}. You can delete it — your notes will arrive alongside it.
dest.secretTitle: Your signing secret — copy it now
dest.secretDetail: Check it against the x-sbg-signature header, which is an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body. We will not show it again.
dest.gaveUp: We gave up on {count} after repeated failures
verify.title: Check a consignment note
verify.lede: Somebody has handed you a consignment note. Type the fingerprint printed at the foot of it and we will tell you whether it is the document this network issued, and whether it has been altered since.
verify.label: The fingerprint on the note
verify.notAFingerprint: A fingerprint is 64 letters and numbers, printed at the foot of the note. Spaces and capitals do not matter.
verify.genuine: This is a document we issued
verify.failedTitle: Could not check it just now
verify.failedDetail: Something went wrong reaching us. Try again in a moment — the answer does not change.
verify.inApp: Check a note somebody sent you
doclink.title: A consignment note, sent to you
doclink.ready.title: Consignment note {number}
doclink.ready.what: It is one file: the note, every copy of it as it was signed, and its photographs. Once you have the file it needs nothing from us.
doclink.ready.leftOne: It can be used once more.
doclink.ready.leftMany: It can be used {n} more times.
doclink.ready.keep: We keep the note itself until {date}. After that nobody can be given another copy, so keep the file.
doclink.expired.title: This link has stopped working
doclink.cancelled.title: This link was cancelled
doclink.cancelled.detail: Whoever it was made for has cancelled it.
doclink.usedUp.title: This link has been used as often as one link can be
doclink.usedUp.detail: A link hands the file over a set number of times, and this one has.
doclink.gone.title: This note is no longer kept
doclink.gone.detail: A consignment note is kept for a set time after its load is finished, and this one has passed it. We cannot give anybody another copy. If you hold a copy, we can still confirm that it is genuine.
doclink.notOurs.title: This is not a link we made
doclink.notOurs.detail: The address may be incomplete: some mail programs cut a long address short. Open it again from the email itself.
doclink.busy.title: Too many tries from here
doclink.busy.detail: Wait a few minutes and try again. The link is not used up by trying.
doclink.unreachable.title: Could not reach us just now
doclink.unreachable.detail: Try again in a moment. The link is not used up by trying.
doclink.askSender: If you should have the note, ask whoever sent you the email: it is theirs to give.
doclink.handed.shared: The file has gone where you sent it.
doclink.handed.failed: The file could not be fetched just now. Try once more.
dreport.title: Damage claim report
dreport.lede: The record of who held this parcel and when, with the photographs, as it stood when the problem was reported. SeeBuyGet does not judge a claim or pay one: the report is yours to keep, and to hand to an insurer or to whoever answers for the goods.
dreport.failed: The report could not be fetched.
dreport.file.save: Download the report and its photographs
dreport.file.share: Share the report and its photographs
dreport.file.hint: One file: the report to read or print, the same facts for a computer, and every photograph that is still kept.
dreport.by.receiver: The receiver, from their own app
dreport.heldByNobody: Nobody’s within the network: it had been handed over
dreport.through.counter: Handed in at a shop’s counter
dreport.through.app: Sent from the sender’s own phone
dreport.photo.contents: The contents, when the parcel was made
dreport.photo.dropOff: At the counter, when it was handed in
dreport.photo.handedOver: At the counter, when it was handed to the receiver
dreport.photo.received: The receiver’s own, of what they received
dreport.photo.problem: The problem, as it was reported
dreport.photo.noneAtAll: No photograph belongs to this parcel.
dreport.terms.theirs: Carried under the carrier’s own promise. No company of the network answers for these goods.
dreport.terms.none: No company of the network answers for these goods.
dreport.terms.covered: {company} states that it pays up to {amount} {currency} from its own books on a parcel like this one.
dreport.terms.noCover: {company} has stated no cover: it pays nothing from its own books. A claim is for your own insurer, the store’s, or whoever answers by law.
dreport.section.parcel: The parcel, as it was made
dreport.fingerprintHint: Two copies with the same fingerprint say the same thing. Whoever you hand the report to can compare theirs with yours.
dreport.section.notes: Added after it was handed over
dreport.note.outside: The receiver added these after the parcel was handed over to them. The report above does not change. What is found inside packaging that arrived whole is outside SeeBuyGet’s jurisdiction: how the goods were packed is for the sender to answer.
dreport.note.withPhotos: ({count, plural, one {# photograph} other {# photographs}} in the file)
dreport.note.title: Found something after it was handed over?
dreport.note.what: The report is the record as it stood when the problem was reported, and it does not change. What you find afterwards — goods broken inside a box that arrived whole — is added beside it as a dated note, with a photograph if you have one. It is outside SeeBuyGet’s jurisdiction: how the goods were packed is for the sender to answer. The sender is told.
dreport.note.label: What you found
dreport.note.added: Your note is on the report, beside it. The sender is told.
dreport.link.ready.notes: With {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} the receiver added after it was handed over.
dreport.fromStill: From {from}, and still when the problem was reported
dreport.heardLate: done with no signal; the phone there dated it, and SeeBuyGet heard of it on {at}
dreport.link.title: Hand it on
dreport.link.lede: A link opens this report for whoever holds it, with nobody signed in. Give it to who should read it and to nobody else: your insurer, the sender, the store.
dreport.link.make: Make a link to pass on
dreport.link.madeDetail: Pass it on now. It works until {date}, and you can stop it here at any time. If you lose it, stop it and make another.
dreport.link.pageTitle: A damage claim report, handed to you
dreport.link.whatItIs: SeeBuyGet carries parcels and keeps the record of every hand each one passes through. This report is that record. It decides nothing about who is at fault and it offers no payment.
dreport.link.askGiver: Ask whoever gave you the link for a new one.
dreport.link.notOurs.title: This is not a link we made
dreport.link.notOurs.detail: The address may have been cut short on the way to you.
dreport.link.busy.title: Too many tries from here just now
dreport.link.busy.detail: Wait a few minutes and try again.
dreport.link.unreachable.title: We could not be reached
dreport.link.unreachable.detail: Check your connection and try again. The link itself is not used up by this.
dreport.link.expired.title: This link has stopped working
dreport.link.cancelled.title: This link was stopped
dreport.link.cancelled.detail: Whoever made it has stopped it.
dreport.link.usedUp.title: This link has been opened as often as one link can be
dreport.link.usedUp.detail: The report itself is still kept.
dreport.link.ready.title: A damage claim report
dreport.link.ready.about: Report {number}, on a parcel from {from} to {to}. The problem was reported on {date}.
dreport.link.ready.what: It holds who held the parcel and when, the photographs, and the terms it travelled under.
dreport.link.ready.until: This link works until {date}. The file is the copy to keep.
dreport.link.ready.fewLeft: It can be opened {count} more times.
dreport.link.row.usedUp: Opened as often as one link can be
dreport.link.row.opened: The file was taken {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}, last on {date}
doclink.own: Your own notes are in your own app, under its records, for as long as we keep them. You do not need a link for those.
archive.links.title: Links to this note
archive.links.lede: A link opens this note without signing in, for whoever has it. Each one stops by itself. Cancel one to stop it now.
archive.links.noneLive: No link to this note works at the moment.
archive.links.showStoppedOne: Show the one that no longer works
archive.links.showStoppedMany: Show the {n} that no longer work
archive.links.hideStopped: Hide the ones that no longer work
archive.links.make: Make a link to pass on
archive.links.makeHint: For somebody who should have this note and has no account here: your bookkeeper, your insurer, the other side. You send it yourself, in a chat, a text or your own mail.
archive.links.madeTitle: This is the link, and it is shown this once
archive.links.madeDetail: It opens this note for whoever has it, until {date}. We do not keep it, so we cannot show it to you again: pass it on now. If it goes astray, cancel it below and make another.
archive.links.passedShared: Handed to the app you chose.
archive.links.passedCopied: Copied. Paste it where you are sending it.
archive.links.passedShown: It could not be copied for you. Press on the link above and copy it yourself.
archive.links.cancelledLeft: Stopped on {date}: the person it was emailed to is no longer in the business
archive.links.cancelledAddress: Stopped on {date}: the person it was emailed to changed their email address
archive.links.usedUp: Used as often as one link can be
archive.links.gone: The note is no longer kept
archive.links.cancelAsk: Cancel this link? It then opens nothing, for anybody, and cannot be switched back on.
fiscal.title: Tax invoice
fiscal.state.waiting: Waiting to be recorded with KRA
fiscal.sandbox: SANDBOX: answered by a stand-in on this laptop, not by KRA
fiscal.number.why: Give your {name} and your tax invoices carry it, so you can claim their VAT back.
fiscal.number.carried: Your tax invoices carry your {name} from the day you gave it.
fiscal.number.emptyRemoves: Leave it empty to take it away.
fiscal.notYet: It can be printed once KRA has recorded it.
fiscal.original: The first time you open it is the original. Every time after, it is marked COPY.
fiscal.gone: The invoice could not be opened. Try again.
sharedIn.title: Shared with SeeBuyGet
sharedIn.editLabel: The message, as it will be sent
sharedIn.copied: Copied. Paste it wherever you need it.
sharedIn.copyFailed: This phone did not let the app copy it. Press and hold the words above to copy them.
sharedIn.chatsLede: Tap a chat and it goes there as a message from you. Like every message, it cannot be taken back.
sharedIn.queued: No signal now. It goes to {who} by itself when the signal comes back.
sharedIn.none.title: No chats yet
sharedIn.none.driver: A chat is about a load. It starts when you ask about one on the Market, and then what you share can go into it. Until then, copy it.
sharedIn.none.agent: A chat is about a load you posted, or a parcel waiting at your shop. It starts when somebody asks about one, and then what you share can go into it. Until then, copy it.
sharedIn.none.vendor: A chat is about a load you posted. It starts when a driver asks about one, and then what you share can go into it. Until then, copy it.
sharedIn.none.send: A chat is with the shop holding a parcel for you. It starts when you message the shop from My parcels, and then what you share can go into it. Until then, copy it.
sharedIn.none.fleet: A chat is about a load, between whoever posted it and the driver asking. Your drivers write in theirs, and you read the ones they share with you. Copy this, and pass it on the way you usually do.
sharedIn.held.title: What you shared waits here for an hour
sharedIn.held.detail: Sign in, and choose the chat to send it to.
common.chat.photo.source.app: taken in the app, at the time
common.chat.photo.source.galleryDated: from the gallery, taken {date} (the phone’s date)
common.chat.photo.source.galleryUndated: from the gallery, no date on it
common.chat.photo.source.unknown: where it came from is not known
common.chat.photo.lede: It is filed to {code} and kept there with its fingerprint; the chat shows where. Once filed, it cannot be taken back.
common.chat.photo.unreadable: This photo could not be read. Take it again, or choose another.
common.chat.photo.noRoom: This phone has no room to keep the photo until the signal comes back. Try again where there is a signal.
common.chat.photo.held: No signal now. The photo waits on this phone and is filed by itself when the signal comes back.
common.chat.photo.waiting: Waiting for a signal — filed on this phone {time}
common.chat.photo.filedOffline: Filed on the phone with no signal, {when}, and sent when the signal came back
common.chat.photo.printPhoto: Fingerprint of the photo as it is kept
common.chat.photo.printOriginal: Fingerprint of the photo as it was on the phone, before it was made smaller to send
common.chat.photo.keptFreight: The poster and the driver carrying the load can open it. Staff see it when a claim is made, or when somebody shares a report of this chat.
common.chat.photo.keptParcel: The shop, the person collecting it and the sender can open it. It goes with the damage claim report if a problem is reported.
common.chat.photo.recordLede: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing you can see has been filed to it.} one {One photo you can see is filed to it.} other {# photos you can see are filed to it.}}
common.chat.photo.fromOther: filed in another chat about it
common.chat.photo.camera.title: Take a photo
common.chat.photo.camera.hint: Hold the phone still, then take the photo.
common.chat.photo.camera.blockedDetail: Allow the camera for this app, or choose the photo from the gallery instead.
sharedIn.photos.what: {count, plural, one {The photo you shared} other {The # photos you shared}}
sharedIn.photos.lede: A photo is filed to a load or a parcel, never sent loose. Say what it is, then choose the chat about that load or parcel.
sharedIn.photos.filed: Filed to {code}, in your chat with {who}.
sharedIn.photos.queued: No signal now. It is filed to {code} by itself when the signal comes back.
sharedIn.photos.notLoaded: A parcel is handed over and delivered, not loaded
sharedIn.photos.none: None of your chats is about a load or a parcel you can file to. A photo is filed from the chat about that load or parcel once there is one.
sharedIn.photos.lost: What you shared did not reach the app. Close the app, then share it once more.
sharedIn.photos.gone: The photos you shared are no longer on this phone. Share them once more.
sharedIn.photos.unreadable: This photo could not be read, so it cannot be filed.
sharedIn.photos.held.title: The photos you shared wait here for an hour
sharedIn.photos.held.detail: Sign in, say what they are, and choose the chat about their load or parcel.
common.manifest.gap.invoice: The commercial invoice, written and signed in SeeBuyGet — a paper one of your own is not enough at Moyale
common.manifest.gap.consignor_tax: The sender’s tax number on the invoice: a KRA PIN in Kenya, a TIN in Ethiopia
common.manifest.gap.consignee_tax: The receiver’s tax number on the invoice: a KRA PIN in Kenya, a TIN in Ethiopia
common.manifest.gap.consignor_country: The sender’s country on the invoice: Kenya or Ethiopia
common.manifest.gap.consignee_country: The receiver’s country on the invoice: Kenya or Ethiopia
common.manifest.gap.hs_codes: Every line’s HS code to 8 digits
common.manifest.gap.export_entry: The export side’s customs number, from the sender or its clearing agent
common.manifest.gap.etims_invoice: The eTIMS invoice number the Kenyan export entry carries
common.manifest.gap.import_declaration: The import side’s customs number — it may follow until the post
common.manifest.gap.vehicle: The vehicle taking the goods over: the driver starts a shift on it
common.manifest.gap.vehicle_country: Where the vehicle is registered, in its papers (the fleet office)
common.manifest.gap.yellow_card: The vehicle’s COMESA Yellow Card, in date, in its papers (the fleet office)
common.manifest.gap.passport: The driver’s passport, in date, recorded by the fleet office or the network
